entries.820d438a1e331540: This segment provides shopping credit, card, loan and payment business. The business is undertaken by consolidated subsidiary Aplus Co., Ltd. (ownership of voting rights 100.0%, as of March 31, 2026), and the guarantee balance of Aplus's credit guarantee business is recorded under “contingent liabilities” and the corresponding contra account on the consolidated balance sheet. Aplus files a securities report and is one of the companies whose ordinary income (excluding transactions between consolidated companies) for the fiscal year ended March 2026 exceeds 10% of consolidated ordinary income. By service, ordinary income from external customers for sales credit business was ¥84,718 million (¥81,147 million in the previous year).
